name: lnav Open-Source Logfile Navigator
free_limit: Free BSD-2-Clause terminal log viewer with automatic format detection, merged chronological logs, filtering and SQLite-based analysis on local files; no vendor-hosted usage quota.
watch_out: Runs locally on user-provided hardware and only analyzes logs the user can access; no hosted log ingestion, storage, alerting service or retention is included. Handle sensitive log data carefully and retain license notices.
